doc: The edits of value-stream-map.md and spec 084 (SC-005) on a two-step stream: a step added, connected, its wait time set in hours, a flow removed, undone and redone. Every byte no edit concerns stays as it was.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.

      to: o1

steps.doc: A new step of the shown state takes the next free id, s3, and goes after the last step, its keys in the binding's order.
